verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based legal document generator, and a product of that kind could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API, API keys or permission scoping, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. The Cooley AI pages describe internal firm tooling, not credentials that users can issue to agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
